paper.title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
paper.central_claim: A123-round study finds a robot can discover capabilities but accepted changes fail to compound; relational-perception substrate, sequential frontier lock and selection-harness errors rather than proposer strength explain stagnation and motivate new loop-design recommendations.
